cross_record_notes: R04 and R05 show substantive context-first improvements in their observed outputs, but both have diagram contract defects of different kinds. This is not an inferred source-version ranking.

No observed reply asks the user to judge implementation quality, spec quality, or a reviewer verdict. Conditional future publishing consent is explicit in most records; the packet confirms no actual publication, and this audit does not infer a runtime consent breach from that prose alone.
R02 and R06 are incomplete interviews and are not penalized for lacking five completed sections.

A fixed five-section structure is approved; findings concern missing roles, unnecessary private inventory, ambiguity, and concrete rendering requirements, not the existence of that structure or an arbitrary word count.
